intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

The requester delegates a complex random concept and reference-based generation to test recently added visual data. This arm independently authors a water-sports rash-guard scene; the precise garment, setting, and action are agent choices, not user-specified details.

Create a photorealistic adventure-fashion photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties using the attached portrait as an appearance reference, preserving her recognizable facial proportions, dark brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair. She is at a flooded tropical mangrove launch, retrieving a floating surfboard after a small broken wave. Her focal swim outfit is a fitted long-sleeve rash guard with a high crew neckline, visible diagonal raglan shoulder seams, and contrasting pale side panels, worn as a separate top over high-waisted swim briefs with curved high-cut leg openings. The rash guard hem overlaps the briefs waistband, while both curved leg openings remain clearly visible. Deep teal stretch swim fabric carries small water beads and gentle tension folds where her arm reaches; the pale side panel stays readable against the darker torso. Her surfboard lies flat on the water beside her, its rounded nose and rail visible, and the wrist nearest it makes clear hand contact with the board rail. A small wave divides around her legs, leaving a curved white foam trail across the dark shallow water. Photograph the interaction in cool overcast with a narrow sunbreak, with bright individual spray droplets suspended beside a softly shaded face. Her body turns three quarters toward camera while her face looks toward the board. Use a vertical full-body composition, enough space around the feet to read the water contact, a natural eye-level viewpoint, and a moderate telephoto perspective. Prioritize legible garment construction, recognizable reference appearance, believable board contact, and the crossing of luminous water droplets over the darker setting.

obligation.composition_instruction: Make the drink's stability physically readable: the near-upright cup has broad visible base contact and slight fabric compression on a fully covered upper-torso support surface, its center of mass stays inside that support, and both hands remain clearly separated.

any_terms: cup on the covered upper torso

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.

concept_terms: one identified image video signal or file process

obligation.composition_instruction: Choose one source medium or protocol and one failure mechanism native to it, confine that mechanism to a deliberate rupture zone, preserve recognizable content across the break, and repeat the same technological fingerprint at three or more separated intersections with the subject or background. Keep ordinary anatomy, object boundaries, text, and texture coherent outside that mechanism, and size the repeated evidence so the authored failure process remains inferable from the image without prompt text or a caption.

any_terms: 원래 장면이 알아볼 수 있게 남음

must_mention_any: repeated technological fingerprint makes the mechanism visibly intentional
matched rupture geometry reveals one authored failure process
the same bounded artifact pattern makes the selected medium failure unmistakable
the mechanism remains inferable from the image alone

render_gates.description: The image visibly commits to one identifiable source medium or protocol rather than an unspecified digital mood.
Artifacts share one technically coherent failure family native to the selected medium or protocol.
A deliberate bounded rupture is compositionally legible instead of uniform decorative noise across the whole frame.
Enough subject and scene continuity survives across the break for the failed flow to remain perceptible.
The result is not carried by generic RGB separation, random static, scanlines, VHS texture, or unrelated effect stacking alone.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can infer the selected source-medium failure mechanism from the same fingerprint repeated at three or more separated image locations; merely noticing that the image looks broken fails.
Malformed anatomy, fused objects, broken text, muddy texture, or one isolated synthesis defect does not carry the intended medium-native glitch.
